nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner

segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily or oily-combo skin report the toner feels light rather than heavy and layers well without an oily film.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing flaky patches, report the toner is hydrating and has not irritated their skin, though one notes it may not be enough alone for very dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe the toner as lightweight, non-greasy, and easy to recommend.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or very sensitive skin, including one with excezma-prone skin, report no irritation or stinging and describe it as calming.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically mention mature skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes it as a good, inoffensive toner suited to normal skin without special or dramatic effects.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the toner as strongly hydrating and lightweight, absorbing quickly and leaving skin plump and supple; one dehydrated-skin reviewer notes it avoids the overhydrated feeling other products caused her.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports decreased redness after two weeks of use alongside the matching cleanser.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry skin reports the toner helped without further irritating an already compromised, flaky barrier.
concerns.spots: Not specifically discussed beyond general acne mentions.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone and sensitive skin reports it helped calm acne and shortened breakout duration; another sensitive-dry-acne-prone reviewer calls it a favorite, though effects are described briefly and not consistently detailed.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner does not leave an oily film and feels light rather than heavy.

extraits.titre: Hydrating and plumping toner with the perfect consistency!
extraits.texte: I am loving this toner from Round Lab! It's packed with birch sap, as well as hyaluronic acid and panthenol. The consistency is slightly thicker than water and not sticky at all. The toner is very hydrating and sinks into the skin nicely but is not heavy, which I love so much since my oily-combo skin can't take heavy layers. This is a very versatile toner, meaning you could use it in the warmer or colder months with ease and any skin type could like this. It also did not irritate my super sensitive skin and is alcohol-free and fragrance-free. Definitely a staple in my routine and will be repurchasing!

The Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner is a great option for those with normal, combination, or even sensitive skin who want a simple, hydrating toner. It provides a good base for further skincare products and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and comfortable. However, if you have very dry skin or are looking for a toner with additional benefits, you might want to consider a different product.

Great toner. Got this for my boyfriend who has very dry skin, and he seems to be loving it. His skin was dry to a point where it would get flakey in spots, but this product hasn't irritated his skin more, and seems to be helping. A nice step before his moisturizer. I got all products from ROUND LAB ROUND that incorporated 'moisturizing' in it's name. Skin has improved a lot.

I got it because I heard a lot of good things. I didn't think much of a hype product. But this toner is so good! It hydrates very well. This toner is a little thicker but makes it easier to apply. I have sensitive dry acne prone skin and this toner is my new favorite!

Flawless oh my gosh. This has truly completed a routine I didn't know was missing anything. After I use my mugwort cleanser, this toner really just sets that moisture in, which I need with my excezma-prone skin. Thank you Round Lab for such phenomenal products.
bought this and the matching cleanser and my skin's redness has decreased so much as well as the duration of my acne! only been using for two weeks. i can't wait to see more improvement

Overall, this toner is very inoffensive and works exactly as I hoped it would. I also feel that the size makes it quite economical, so I'm pretty pleased with it. I would say that the hydration I get from this is not particularly special and it's not exactly a stand out product, but it doesn't irritate my skin like most other toners and is more affordable. If you're not one who cares to follow what's trending much and prefer economical options, I suggest trying this out.
